name: sup-single-candidate
notes: The simplest `previous-superset` shape: one wide run (`A`, selector `[]`) is the only series-mate of the narrow current run (`B`, selector `['src']`). The vitest adapter proves `A` a superset of `B` (empty selector selects the whole inventory), so it is the sole candidate and trivially maximal -- no `baseline.superset_candidates` disclosure (only ever set at >=2 maximal candidates). `tests/out.test.ts` (red) falls outside `B`'s narrower selector and is disclosed via `transitions.out_of_scope`, never claimed `repaired`. The `selector-subset` surface event discloses both selectors (`from` the empty baseline selector, `to` the narrow current one) and the proving capability.
